title: 9 Times a Godly Man Moves First (So No One Else Has To)
caption:
9 times a godly man moves first. So no one else has to.

He breaks the silence everyone's waiting on someone else to break. He calls before the distance turns permanent. He offers before he's asked, his time, his ride, his weekend. He owns his part of the story before anyone brings the receipts. He texts the guy who's gone quiet in the group chat.

He takes the blame before it lands on someone who didn't earn it. He starts the conversation his own father never started with him. He gives before he's counted who's watching. And he lets go of his own plan the moment he senses God redirecting it.

Somebody always has to go first. Make it you.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
